assertions.summary: BGP and forwarding configuration is coherent and persistent, but temporary/debug residue remains and node1 reports failed SONiC system units.

evidence.command:
hostname; printf '%s
' 'addresses'; ip -o -4 addr show; printf '%s
' 'main-routes'; ip -o route show table main; printf '%s
' 'static-routes'; ip route show table main proto static; printf '%s
' 'rules'; ip rule; printf '%s
' 'forwarding'; sysctl net.ipv4.ip_forward net.ipv4.conf.all.forwarding net.ipv4.conf.eth1.forwarding net.ipv4.conf.eth2.forwarding; printf '%s
' 'docker0'; ip -4 addr show dev docker0 2>&1; printf '%s
' 'failed-units'; systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain 2>&1; printf '%s
' 'reconcilers-and-ssh'; systemctl is-enabled interfaces-config.service networking.service systemd-networkd.service ssh.service sshd.service 2>&1; printf '%s
' 'debug-processes'; ps -eo pid,user,comm,args | grep -E '[t]cpdump|[s]trace|[s]truss|[d]ebug' 2>&1; printf '%s
' 'temporary-artifacts'; find /tmp /var/tmp -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name '*.pcap*' -o -name '*.cap' -o -name '*.sh' -o -name '*.tar*' -o -name '*bgp*' -o -name '*antrieb*' \) -print 2>/dev/null; printf '%s
